description: Recent liquidations for BTC (aggregated long vs short liquidation USD over the latest period). Example: coinglass_liquidations({ symbol: "BTC", _apiKey: "your-key" })

exchange.description: Optional — comma-separated exchange list to aggregate, e.g. "Binance,OKX,Bybit" (default: Binance,OKX,Bybit)

interval.description: Optional — aggregation window: 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,1w (default "1d" for a 24h view)

name: coinglass_liquidations
title: Coinglass Liquidations
